payload.text: **LESSONS candidates, 2026-09-18, vc's call at a fold (drop is the expected outcome -- todo 63).** (a) **A non-vacuity floor found a reader defect, not only an empty scan**: 0087's class arm demanded 4 split sites, read 3, and the missing one was a span ended early by a ` -- ` INSIDE a quoted --source -- both class arms had shared that blind spot. (b) **A staleness check measured against today's renderer cannot be applied to a frozen artefact**: status read devbin's own v0.1.1 as unstamped; running a new reader on the real project found it where fixtures could not. (c) **vc wrote a must-pass control that was itself a hole** (`mv -f x '-n'` -- quote removal makes it -n); a control is a claim and gets driven like one. (d) **vc sent a peer a placeholder sha ('82xx')** and corrected it in the next message; fill every reference before a send. (e) A mutant anchor on text shared by two sites was refused by the script's count==1 check -- keep that check in every mutation harness.
